topic: K-Stick and the Alarm Clock That Snoozes Him
hook_text: What if your alarm could hit snooze on YOU?

scenes.story_text: K-Stick proudly sets the alarm for one minute later, gives a confident thumbs-up, and lies down.
The alarm rings loudly. K-Stick reaches over and taps the snooze button, but the clock displays: "SNOOZING K-STICK." K-Stick instantly droops and falls asleep.
K-Stick jolts awake and points angrily at the clock. The alarm rings again, but the clock grows a tiny stick arm and presses its own snooze button.
The clock displays "Just five more minutes" while K-Stick quietly climbs back into bed and gives it a grateful thumbs-up.
